title: 'Wallace and Gromit,' 90% Alone
summary: This article from Animation Obsessive explores the making of Wallace and Gromit animations, likely focusing on the remarkably independent production process where Nick Park and his small Aardman team create these beloved claymation films with minimal external involvement.
problem_solved: Provides insight into how traditional hand-crafted animation techniques can compete with modern CGI through dedication and craftsmanship.
why_valuable: Reveals the behind-the-scenes craft and passion behind iconic British animation, demonstrating that small dedicated teams can create world-class entertainment.
